freezeManifestV2.preservedFailedReleaseReportNote: In initial release-m4opt10, SpecRCTTests.cancellationIsBoundedAndDeadlineCallbackIsHonoured failed at Tests/SwiftJXLCoreTests/SpecRCTTests.swift:55:9 (tests.log line 2046) because the previous SpecRCT.inverse checkpoint interval was 4096 triples; ModularGradientTests passed at tests.log line 1006. Restoring the checkpoint interval from 4096 triples to 1024 triples (3072 operations) in SpecRCT.inverse allowed the third-checkpoint cancellation test to preserve a.suffix(2048) and pass release-m4opt10-v2.
